I’d block on **one issue** in `3ebff74`:

**[P1] Team and archive quotas become zero** — `src/plans.js:11`
`entry.quotaKiB << 10` uses JavaScript’s 32-bit bitwise arithmetic, so both paid-plan quotas overflow to `0` instead of 200 GiB and 2 TiB. I reproduced a 1-byte upload being rejected on an empty account for each plan.

Use multiplication by `1024` rather than a bit shift, and cover both paid plans in tests before merging.

All 4 existing tests pass; they only exercise the free-plan quota. No code changed.
